assets.name: banner-mobile-v1
assets.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a finished premium Korean cooking-class promotion raster banner using the FOUR supplied images as supporting visual references: orange bento box, exactly five sushi pieces, exactly two sauce pots, warm subtle paper texture. Match their friendly rounded clay 3D look. Main requirement: generous spatial negative space, warm off-white paper texture, premium simple layout. About half of the decorative object groups should extend beyond the banner boundaries and be deliberately cropped, while the headline and CTA remain entirely visible and legible. Brand orange #ff5a1f, neutral nearly-black #1a1a1a, ivory. Korean modern sans-serif typography like Pretendard, bold headline, concise orange rounded CTA. Text must be EXACTLY: headline '심심한 주말 놓치지 아까운 기회' and button '요리 수업 알아보기'. No other text, numbers, logos, watermark. No people. This is a cooking community's cooking workshop ad, not a payment or banking ad. Requested output 720 by 360 pixels, 2:1 wide banner. Put headline in two balanced lines in the left-centre with CTA below, large clear breathing room around text. Bento partly cropped off upper-right, grouped sushi partly cropped off lower-right, sauce pots smaller near lower edge. Keep centre airy, not cluttered. Compose all content for this exact 2:1 canvas.
